standard_calibration.assembly: Factory-only soldering and socket population; factory adjustment through accessible test points.
standard_calibration.pitch_tracking_scope: 0..5 V at 25 C after factory calibration; target only, not guaranteed by resistor tolerance. #29 defines sweep and temperature characterization.
standard_calibration.sample_hold: No long-hold pitch accuracy promise; characterize droop separately from output load error.
standard_calibration.pitch_voltage_error_caveat: 5 cents at 1 V/oct equals 4.166667 mV; oscillator exponential/core error and temperature must share this total budget. A 2 mV octave-step target alone does not prove five-octave tracking.
